lsp-type-checker.spec.ts type-checks apps/analog-app, which resolves
@analogjs/router from packages/router/dist. vite-plugin-angular has no
graph dependency on router, so with --skip-nx-cache its tests could run
while router:build had cleaned dist, failing with TS2307 (seen in
vite-ecosystem-ci). Add router:build as a task dependency of test.
